description: Per-file content provenance for the W4-B skills: show-me-your-work, recall, automate-me, create-verification-skill, maintain-verification-skill and make-bot-ui. Owned by the W4-B writer; see test/skill-content.test.ts for the rules.

files.explanation: Adapted from the pinned pi-mimir file. The transcript audit keeps $PI_SESSION_FILE and replaces the nonexistent recall tool with the per-cwd session directory rule in ../poteto-mode/playbooks/session-pickup.md, never another project's sessions. A start row's evidence names the run's session file instead of an agent id. Committing the log also requires the task's commit policy (references/authorization.md). The short principle name becomes principle-encode-lessons-in-structure. The cross-model trail review becomes a fan-out.md diversity seat: one schema-valid bare subagent example with the delegation.md Reviewer prompt, an exact <provider>/<model-id> from another family, tools read, bash and fork false, given the log path and the parent's session file path; with no other family it runs same-family and is labelled context-isolated in the Attention line; a child keeping a trail launches no reviewer and leaves the review to its parent. Cursor's agent-transcripts wording and missing illustration sentence are not used.
